caption: Epitope Bin Spatial Validation on RBD (PDB 8SGU)
description: 2D top-down projection (X-Z plane) of RBD Cα backbone (grey dots) with 12 epitope bin centroids (colored circles). Each centroid is the weighted center of mass of RBD residues, weighted by the mean per-residue DMS escape score across all antibodies in that bin. Spatial separation confirms the 12 bins correspond to distinct epitope regions.
